caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) consistently improves as the number of training examples increases (x-axis). Max is 29k examples, the full size of our dataset.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the average performance across 11 datasets as a function of the number of training examples. The x-axis, labeled "# of training dataset (k)", displays a linear scale ranging from 5 to 30, with tick intervals of 5 units. The y-axis, labeled "Average performance (k)", runs from 47 to 56, with tick intervals of 1 unit. A single solid black line represents the average performance, beginning at approximately 47.8 at x=5 and increasing linearly to approximately 56 at x=30.
